subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add DAG-safe selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-target composer routing, or declare current session groups and whole-session forks the supported boundary?
rationale: Current main covers organization but not the requested transcript mutation and fanout; those remaining behaviors require intentional product semantics for copied context, ancestry, idempotency, and target ownership.

options.title: Add bounded branch/copy
options.body: Keep sessions canonical and define explicit message-level branch or copy operations plus typed single-or-multiple route targets.

options.title: Current boundary is sufficient
options.body: Treat custom groups, whole-session forks, lifecycle actions, and split panes as the complete supported workflow and close the remaining request.

options.title: Introduce first-class Projects
options.body: Create a durable Project entity across Gateway, storage, routing, and Control UI and accept the larger product contract.

recommendation.title: Add bounded branch/copy
recommendation.body: Keep sessions canonical and define explicit message-level branch or copy operations plus typed single-or-multiple route targets.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the project owner, has already reviewed this exact product boundary, and is the strongest available owner for choosing whether the remaining semantics belong in core.
